name: Yahiko (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yahiko village emblem in white: a ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised mountain peak.
history: Municipal flag of Yahiko, a village in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 1968.

features.role: Yahiko village emblem — a ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised mountain peak
